name: F5 the book of tales (save / load)

steps.note: 1. boot: three tales + autosave, read straight from localStorage

steps.msg: slots 1/3/auto hold tales, slot 2 is an empty page

steps.assert: (() => { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dqv.save.1')); return ['v','at','playtime','chapter','flags','party','inventory','gold','map','pos'].every(k => k in d) && d.v === 2 && /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/.test(d.sum); })()
steps.msg: stored page has the ARCHITECTURE contract shape + version + checksum

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[0]; return s.hero === 'Bram' && s.level === 6 && s.act === 'Act I' && s.placeName === 'Cobwell Manor' && s.playtimeText === '1:12' && s.party.length === 3; })()
steps.msg: slot summary for the title screen: hero, level, act, place, playtime, party
boot carried on from the most recent tale (the autosave)
subsystems registered, loaded in contract order

steps.note: 2. keyboard: pick the empty page, write the tale down

steps.msg: cursor moved to Tale 2
command window focused on Write it down
cancel backs out to the slot list

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[1]; return s.status === 'ok' && s.hero === 'Bram' && s.level === 7 && s.copies.page && s.copies.copy; })()
steps.msg: Tale 2 written: page + copy

steps.note: 3. writing over a tale asks first, and keeps the old page as the spare

steps.msg: overwrite confirmation opened

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[0]; return s.status === 'ok' && s.level === 9 && s.copies.spare === true; })()
steps.msg: Tale 1 overwritten (Lv 9), old page kept as the spare

steps.note: 4. spill ink on the page: the second copy has every word

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[0]; return s.status === 'copy' && s.loadable && s.seq === window.__t1.seq && s.level === 9; })()
steps.msg: smudged page -> read from the copy, nothing lost
loaded the rescued tale into the game

steps.note: 5. smudge both copies: the spare page from before is used

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[0]; return s.status === 'backup' && s.loadable && s.level === 6; })()
steps.msg: both copies smudged -> the spare (the previous page, Lv 6)
the spare loads

steps.note: 6. ruin all three copies of Tale 3: nothing crashes

steps.msg: ruined slot reads as broken, load refuses gently, no errors

steps.note: 7. the escape hatch: copy Tale 2 as a code, paste it into the ruined Tale 3

steps.msg: export produced a code and showed it
a muddled code (or any random JSON) changes nothing

steps.assert: (() => { const a = __DQ.saves()[1], b = __DQ.saves()[2]; return b.status === 'ok' && b.hero === a.hero && b.level === a.level && b.placeName === a.placeName; })()
steps.msg: code brought the tale back into Tale 3

steps.note: 8. the candle goes out mid-write: the new words survive in the copy

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[1]; return s.status === 'copy' && s.loadable && s.seq > window.__s2.seq && __DQ.raw(2).copy.seq === s.seq && __DQ.raw(2).page.seq === window.__s2.seq; })()
steps.msg: interrupted write: reader picks the newer complete copy

steps.note: 9. a full disk: the write fails politely and the old page is untouched

steps.msg: write on a stuffed bag reports 'full'

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[1]; return s.status === window.__s2.status && s.seq === window.__s2.seq; })()
steps.msg: old page intact after the failed write
after tidying the junk, writing works again

steps.note: 10. old books migrate, books from the future are shown but never loaded

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[3]; return s.loadable && s.migratedFrom === 0 && s.hero === 'Bram' && s.level === 3 && s.placeName === 'Saltmarrow'; })()
steps.msg: v0 prototype save migrates to v2

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[0]; return s.loadable && s.migratedFrom === 1 && s.party.length === 2; })()
steps.msg: v1 contract-shape save migrates to v2
the migrated page loads
future page recognised and shown
future page is never loaded
writing over a future page keeps it as the spare

steps.note: 11. a grumpy subsystem that throws in save() and load() cannot stop the book

steps.msg: write succeeds without the grumpy helper

steps.assert: (() => { const r = __DQ.read(1); return r.ok === true && r.failed.length === 0; })()
steps.msg: load still works
the only errors are the grumpy helper's deliberate ones

steps.note: 12. no storage at all: an in-memory shelf, with a warning

steps.msg: locked shelf -> memory backend, still playable
unlocked -> the real tales are back

steps.note: 13. autosave on map.enter, throttled; playtime counts

steps.msg: map.enter wrote the autosave
rapid map changes collapse into one trailing write
...which lands after the gap
playtime clock is running

steps.note: 14. tear out a page, then put it back

steps.msg: page torn out

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.saves()[1]; return s.status === 'ok' && s.seq === window.__s2.seq; })()
steps.msg: undo restored the same page

steps.note: 15. chaos: 200 random mishaps, every promise checked after each one

steps.eval: (() => { const r = __DQ.chaos(200, 5); window.__chaos = r; return {ok: r.ok, ops: r.ops, throws: r.throws, violations: r.violations.slice(0, 5), writes: r.writes, rescued: r.rescued, ms: r.ms}; })()

steps.msg: 200 mishaps: no throws, no broken promises
chaos included a full disk, and cleaned up after itself

steps.eval: (() => { const r = __DQ.chaos(200, 11); window.__chaos2 = r; return {ok: r.ok, throws: r.throws, violations: r.violations.slice(0, 5)}; })()

steps.msg: ...and again with another seed
chaos produced no unexpected errors

steps.note: 16. tidy up, then reload the page: the book persists

steps.eval: (() => { window.name = JSON.stringify(__DQ.saves().map(s => [s.status, s.hero, s.level, s.placeName, s.seq])); return window.name; })()

steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__DQ.saves().map(s => [s.status, s.hero, s.level, s.placeName, s.seq])) === window.name
steps.msg: after a reload every slot reads back identically
clean boot after reload
fps >= 55
